11009-labor-s-martyrs-haymarket-1887-sac.title: Labor S Martyrs Haymarket 1887 Sacco And Vanzetti 1927
11009-labor-s-martyrs-haymarket-1887-sac.creator: Vito Marcantonio
11009-labor-s-martyrs-haymarket-1887-sac.description: A book by Vito Marcantonio. Once again labor is making a vast surge forward, but on a much higher political level. In 1886, and the years following, the best that the working class could do in the way of organization was to produce the craft union movement, which, notwithstanding all its failings, was an advance in liveability at least, over the amorphous and confused Knights of Labor.

29334-the-colonial-architecture-of-phila.title: The Colonial Architecture Of Philadelphia
29334-the-colonial-architecture-of-phila.creator: Unknown
29334-the-colonial-architecture-of-phila.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. as was the provincial life of this community; absorbing as are the reminiscences attaching to its well-known early buildings; important as were the activities of those who made them part and parcel of our national life, the Colonial architecture of this vicinity is in itself a priceless heritage--extensive, meritorious, substantial, distinctive.

arxiv-2106-08215.title: A Physically-informed Graph-based Order Parameter for the Universal Characterization of Atomic Structures
arxiv-2106-08215.creator: James Chapman, Nir Goldman, Brandon Wood
arxiv-2106-08215.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by James Chapman, Nir Goldman, Brandon Wood. A new graph-based order parameter is introduced for the characterization of atomistic structures. The order parameter is universal to any material/chemical system, and is transferable to all structural geometries.

arxiv-2106-13394.title: Countering Adversarial Examples: Combining Input Transformation and Noisy Training
arxiv-2106-13394.creator: Cheng Zhang, Pan Gao
arxiv-2106-13394.description: Abstract Recent studies have shown that neural network (NN) based image classifiers are highly vulnerable to adversarial examples, which poses a threat to security-sensitive image recognition task. Prior work has shown that JPEG compression can combat the drop in classification accuracy on adversarial examples to some extent.

arxiv-2212-07067.title: Concurrence Triangle Induced Genuine Multipartite Entanglement Measure
arxiv-2212-07067.creator: Zhi-Xiang Jin, Yuan-Hong Tao, Yao-Ting Gui, Shao-Ming Fei, Xianqing Li-Jost, Cong-Feng Qiao
arxiv-2212-07067.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhi-Xiang Jin, Yuan-Hong Tao, Yao-Ting Gui, Shao-Ming Fei, Xianqing Li-Jost, Cong-Feng Qiao. We study the quantification of genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) for general multipartite states. A set of inequalities satisfied by the entanglement of N N -partite pure states is derived by exploiting the restrictions on entanglement distributions, showing that the bipartite entanglement between each part and its remaining ones cannot exceed the sum of the other partners with their remaining ones.

arxiv-2312-17669.title: Spin-orbit coupling tuned crossover of gaped and gapless topological phases in the chalcopyrite HgSnX 2 (X=N/P): An ab-initio investigation
arxiv-2312-17669.creator: Surasree Sadhukhan, Sudipta Kanungo
arxiv-2312-17669.description: Abstract The coupling between electron orbital momentum and spin momentum, known as spin-orbit coupling (SOC), is a fundamental origin of a multitude of fascinating physical phenomena, especially it holds paramount significance in the realm of topological materials. In our work, we have predicted the topological phase in Hg-based chalcopyrite compounds using the first principles density functional theory.

arxiv-2407-10427.title: Transformer for Multitemporal Hyperspectral Image Unmixing Thanks: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under the Grant 62125102, the Natural Science Foundation of Tianjin under the Grant 23JCQNJC00010 and Natural Science Foundation of Tianjin under Grant 23JCQ
arxiv-2407-10427.creator: Hang Li, Qiankun Dong, Xueshuo Xie, Xia Xu*, Tao Li*
arxiv-2407-10427.description: Abstract Multitemporal hyperspectral image unmixing (MTHU) holds significant importance in monitoring and analyzing the dynamic changes of surface. However, compared to single-temporal unmixing, the multitemporal approach demands comprehensive consideration of information across different phases, rendering it a greater challenge. To address this challenge, we propose the Multitemporal Hyperspectral Image Unmixing Transformer (MUFormer), an end-to-end unsupervised deep learning model.

arxiv-2410-12256.title: Voter Participation Control in Online Polls
arxiv-2410-12256.creator: Koustav De email: koustavde7@kgpian.iitkgp.ac.in, Palash Dey email: palash.dey@cse.iitkgp.ac.in, Swagato Sanyal email: swagato@cse.iitkgp.ac.in
arxiv-2410-12256.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Koustav De email: koustavde7@kgpian.iitkgp.ac.in, Palash Dey email: palash.dey@cse.iitkgp.ac.in, Swagato Sanyal email: swagato@cse.iitkgp.ac.in. News outlets, surveyors, and other organizations often conduct polls on social networks to gain insights into public opinion. Such a poll is typically started by someone on a social network who sends it to her friends. If a person participates in the poll, the poll information gets published on her wall, which in turn enables her friends to participate, and the process continues.

arxiv-2503-06744.title: CoDa-4DGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting with Context and Deformation Awareness for Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2503-06744.creator: Rui Song, Chenwei Liang, Yan Xia, Walter Zimmer, Hu Cao, Holger Caesar, Andreas Festag, Alois Knoll
arxiv-2503-06744.description: Abstract Dynamic scene rendering opens new avenues in autonomous driving by enabling closed-loop simulations with photorealistic data, which is crucial for validating end-to-end algorithms. However, the complex and highly dynamic nature of traffic environments presents significant challenges in accurately rendering these scenes.

britannica-1911-morosini.title: Morosini (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-morosini.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-morosini.description: Article 'Morosini' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Andrea Morosini (1558–1618) was a famous historian and was entrusted by the Venetian senate with the task of continuing Paolo Paruta’s Annali Veneti, in Latin. His history of Venice was published by his brother in 1623 (Venice), and translated into  Italian by Senator Girolamo Molin (Venice, 1782). Among his other works are: Le Imprese ed espeditioni di terra santa, &c.

pmc-10650066.title: Neurotrophic and Neuroprotective Effects of Hericium erinaceus
pmc-10650066.creator: Izabela Szućko-Kociuba, Alicja Trzeciak-Ryczek, Patrycja Kupnicka, Dariusz Chlubek, Anne Vejux
pmc-10650066.description: Hericium erinaceus is a valuable mushroom known for its strong bioactive properties. It shows promising potential as an excellent neuroprotective agent, capable of stimulating nerve growth factor release, regulating inflammatory processes, reducing oxidative stress, and safeguarding nerve cells from apoptosis.

pmc-10655348.title: Erythropoietin suppresses osteoblast apoptosis and ameliorates steroid-induced necrosis of the femoral head in rats by inhibition of STAT1-caspase 3 signaling pathway
pmc-10655348.creator: Tingwen Cai, Siyuan Chen, Chenghu Wu, Chao Lou, Weidan Wang, Chihao Lin, Hongyi Jiang, Xinxian Xu
pmc-10655348.description: BackgroundSteroid-induced avascular necrosis of the femoral head (SANFH) is characterized by osteoblast apoptosis, leading to a loss of bone structure and impaired hip joint function. It has been demonstrated that erythropoietin (EPO) performs a number of biological roles.ObjectiveWe examined the effects of EPO on SANFH and its regulation of the STAT1-caspase 3 signaling pathway.

pmc-11457525.title: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum 299V-fermented soy whey improved the safety and shelf life of Pacific oysters (Magallana gigas)
pmc-11457525.creator: Lipin Chen, Qian Hua, Mei Zhen Michelle Ten, Zhaojie Li, Changhu Xue, Dan Li
pmc-11457525.description: This study developed a postbiotic fermentation solution for fresh oyster preservation with the use of food waste soy whey. Lactiplantibacillus plantarum 299V was able to proliferate in soy whey within 24 h without any supplementation. Pacific oysters (Magallana gigas) were immersed in the postbiotic fermentation solution and stored at 4 °C for 12 days.

pmc-11486790.title: Caloric restriction mimetics improve gut microbiota: a promising neurotherapeutics approach for managing age-related neurodegenerative disorders
pmc-11486790.creator: Ishika Singh, Shashi Anand, Deepashree J Gowda, Amitha Kamath, Abhishek Kumar Singh
pmc-11486790.description: The gut microbiota (GM) produces various molecules that regulate the physiological functionality of the brain through the gut-brain axis (GBA). Studies suggest that alteration in GBA may lead to the onset and progression of various neurological dysfunctions. Moreover, aging is one of the prominent causes that contribute to the alteration of GBA.

pmc-11509055.title: Curcumin and Methotrexate: A Promising Combination for Osteosarcoma Treatment via Hedgehog Pathway Inhibition
pmc-11509055.creator: Giulia Giliberti, Maria Maddalena Marrapodi, Giuseppe Di Feo, Elvira Pota, Martina Di Martino, Daniela Di Pinto, Francesca Rossi, Alessandra Di Paola, Virinder Kaur Sarhadi, Francesca Perut
pmc-11509055.description: Osteosarcoma (OS) is the most severe bone tumor in children. A chemotherapy regimen includes a combination of high-dose Methotrexate (MTX), doxorubicin, and cisplatin. These drugs cause acute and chronic side effects, such as infections, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, DNA damage, and inflammation. Therefore, to identify new therapeutic strategies, effective and with a safety profile, is necessary.

pmc-11611143.title: Correction: Evaluation of a parasite-density based pooled targeted amplicon deep sequencing (TADS) method for molecular surveillance of Plasmodium falciparum drug resistance genes in Haiti
pmc-11611143.creator: Swarnali Louha, Camelia Herman, Mansi Gupta, Dhruviben Patel, Julia Kelley, Je-Hoon M. OH, Janani Guru, Jean F. Lemoine, Michelle A. Chang, Udhayakumar Venkatachalam, Eric Rogier, Eldin Talundzic
pmc-11611143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). alaria Branch, Division of Parasitic Diseases and Malaria, Center for Global Health, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Atlanta, GA, USA. The publisher apologizes for the error. An additional affiliation is missing for the first author. Swarnali Louha is also affiliated with Malaria Branch, Division of Parasitic Diseases and Malaria, Center for Global Health, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Atlanta, GA, USA. An additional affiliation is missing for the second author.

pmc-11654298.title: NERVE 2.0: boosting the new enhanced reverse vaccinology environment via artificial intelligence and a user-friendly web interface
pmc-11654298.creator: Andrea Conte, Nicola Gulmini, Francesco Costa, Matteo Cartura, Felix Bröhl, Francesco Patanè, Francesco Filippini
pmc-11654298.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundVaccines development in this millennium started by the milestone work on Neisseria meningitidis B, reporting the invention of Reverse Vaccinology (RV), which allows to identify vaccine candidates (VCs) by screening bacterial pathogens genome or proteome through computational analyses. When NERVE (New Enhanced RV Environment), the first RV software integrating tools to perform the selection of VCs, was released, it prompted further development in the field.

pmc-11663469.title: Fidaxomicin versus oral vancomycin for Clostridioides difficile infection among patients at high risk for recurrence based on real-world experience
pmc-11663469.creator: Natasha N Pettit, Alison K Lew, Cynthia T Nguyen, Elizabeth Bell, Christopher J Lehmann, Jennifer Pisano
pmc-11663469.description: Introduction:Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) is a common nosocomial infection and is associated with a high healthcare burden due to high rates of recurrence. In 2021 the IDSA/SHEA guideline update recommended fidaxomicin (FDX) as first-line therapy. Our medical center updated our institutional guidelines to follow these recommendations, prioritizing FDX use among patients at high risk for recurrent CDI (rCDI).

pmc-12523113.title: Exploring pediatric onset Still’s disease patient journey and parental perceptions in Türkiye through a survey
pmc-12523113.creator: Mehmet Yildiz, Elif Kilic Konte, Nergis Akay, Hatice Kubra Zora, Umit Gul, Kubra Ucak, Ece Aslan, Berkant Ersoy, Nihal Sahin, Elif Celikel, Boran Saracoglu, Sara Sebnem Kilic, Banu Celikel Acar, Ozgur Kasapcopur
pmc-12523113.description: ObjectiveThis survey-based study aimed to explore the journey to the diagnosis and management of children with pediatric onset Still’s disease (PoSD) in Türkiye. This sought to understand parents’ perceptions, feelings, and expectations, enabling the identification of unmet needs and fostering improvements in PoSD care.

pmc-12656509.title: Characterization of Endoglucanase (GH9) Gene Family in Tomato and Its Expression in Response to Rhizophagus irregularis and Sclerotinia sclerotiorum
pmc-12656509.creator: Yolani de Jesús Bojórquez-Armenta, Luis Gerardo Sarmiento-López, María J. Pozo, Claudia Castro-Martínez, Melina Lopez-Meyer
pmc-12656509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this study, we report bioinformatics analysis of the endoglucanase GH9 gene family in tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) using the SL5.0 genome, confirming the presence of 19 members that clustered into classes A, B, and C. To explore their potential role in plant–microbe interactions, we determined the transcriptional regulation of 10 SlGH9 gene members in tomato leaves and roots during interactions with the mutualistic root mycorrhizal fungus Rhizophagus irregularis and the foliar pathogen Sclerotinia sclerotiorum.

pmc-13233372.title: cGAS-STING pathway mediation in osteoclast function and bone fracture healing
pmc-13233372.creator: Miaomiao Zheng, Li Zhao, Shensheng Nian, Qiang Wei, Panyu Zhou, Hao Tang
pmc-13233372.description: ObjectiveThe cGAS-STING pathway serves as a key mediator of inflammation. The aim of this study is to explore the biological role and molecular mechanisms of the cGAS-STING pathway in the fracture healing process, with a particular focus on its function during the early inflammatory phase.

pmc-13314390.title: Evaluation of the Anti-Inflammatory and Antioxidant Properties of Mangifera indica var. teloor Extract
pmc-13314390.creator: Yun Ji Park, Rusea Go, Mohd Nazre Salleh, Jin Hyub Paik, Sang Jin Jo, Sung Keun Jung

pmc-13342861.creator: Akin Nihat, Parineeta Arora, Christian Schmidt, Melissa L. D. Rayner, Jacqueline Linehan, Sebastian Brandner, Simon Mead, John Collinge, Parmjit S. Jat

pmc-13407092.title: Aldosterone-identified targets for optimal sodium and potassium supplementation in intestinal failure
pmc-13407092.creator: Robert H. Foerster, Georg Lamprecht, Mads V. Sørensen, Jens Leipziger, Peder Berg
pmc-13407092.description: BackgroundParenteral support (PS) is a life-saving organ replacement therapy for patients with intestinal failure (IF). However, practical strategies to establish optimal PS sodium and potassium remain poorly defined. We investigated whether elevated plasma renin and aldosterone reflect suboptimal electrolyte supplementation and could help guide physiologically optimal sodium and potassium supplementation in patients with IF.

pmc-13651048.creator: Rosa C van Hoorn, Laurens C van Gestel, Diana Harteveld-Griffioen, Mariska WF Petrignani, Coco Kersten, Margriet Müskens, Laura Vols, Hanneke Borgdorff, Irene M van der Meer, Marieke A Adriaanse, Adriënne S van der Schoor
pmc-13651048.description: BackgroundAvian Influenza (AI) is a potential pandemic threat, specifically when human-to-human transmission occurs. In order to mitigate potential outbreaks amongst humans, testing is essential. l. It is necessary to identify determinants of testing behaviour for AI in an early phase, as current knowledge on testing behaviour is mostly derived from other infectious diseases such as COVID-19.

uslaw-cfr-t21-s882-5810.title: 21 C.F.R. § 882.5810 — External functional neuromuscular stimulator.
uslaw-cfr-t21-s882-5810.creator: Food And Drug Administration, Department Of Health And Human Services
uslaw-cfr-t21-s882-5810.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 21 (Food and Drugs), Part 882 (Neurological Devices). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) Identification. An external functional neuromuscular stimulator is an electrical stimulator that uses external electrodes for stimulating muscles in the leg and ankle of partially paralyzed patients (e.g., after stroke) to provide flexion of the foot and thus improve the patient's gait.
